interface.shortDescription: Run Codex-native CCG with optional Gemini review and local quality gates
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native CCG fork where Codex owns planning, implementation, and verification. External intelligence is opt-in and disabled by default, Gemini may provide bounded read-only evidence, Claude is disabled, and GPT Pro remains manual-only. Includes hardened snapshots, canonical evidence, Git/context helpers, spec and team workflows, and local quality/security gates.
